meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye **Minimalist 10% Advanced Vitamin C Serum** meri first recommendation hai—beginner-friendly, stable vitamin C formula aur usually reasonable price mein milta hai.[1][4] Agar skin sensitive hai, **Foxtale 10% Vitamin C-Glutathione** ya **Dr. Sheth’s Ceramide & 10% Vitamin C Ampoule** jaise gentler options dekhein.[2][10]

**Skin type ke hisaab se:**
- **Beginner/combination skin:** Minimalist 10% Vitamin C.
- **Oily ya acne-prone skin:** The Derma Co 10% Vitamin C + 5% Niacinamide; niacinamide oil control aur uneven tone mein help kar sakta hai.[2][9]
- **Sensitive/dry skin:** Foxtale 10% Vitamin C-Glutathione ya Dr. Sheth’s Ceramide + Vitamin C.[2][10]
- **Pehle se vitamin C use kar chuke hain aur stubborn spots hain:** Plum 15% ya Biluma 15%; high strength ko dheere introduce karein.[1][8]

**Kaise use karein:**
1. Subah cleanser ke baad 2–3 drops, phir moisturizer.
2. Roz **SPF 50 broad-spectrum sunscreen** lagayein—sunscreen ke bina dark spots wapas dark ho sakte hain aur serum ka result weak rahega.[8][10]
3. Pehle 2 hafton tak alternate days use karein; irritation na ho to daily.
4. Patch test karein. Ek hi routine mein vitamin C ke saath glycolic acid, salicylic acid ya retinol shuru na karein.

**Best simple routine:**  
Morning: Cleanser → Minimalist 10% Vitamin C → Moisturizer → SPF 50.  
Visible improvement ko aam taur par 8–12 weeks dein; painful acne, melasma ya rapidly changing spots ke liye dermatologist se milna behtar hai.
